item: Row 361 group 10: the chronology summary and timeline follow a language switch
summary: Diagnostics' chronology summary is built by _chronoSummaryHtml, a top-level function that translates inside itself, so the frozen-renderer scan cannot count it (row 365 names the blind spot) and it stayed in the first language after a switch. _chronoRender now marks the summary off the walker and chronoRepaint, called from app-boot's one oo:langchange listener, draws the summary and the timeline again from the reading held; never fetches, and only once a reading was drawn. Not through ooLive: the live since-restart counter inside the summary is written every second, which the helper would read as a foreign write. Removes no list line. No new strings.
